messages.content: In which exact pandas version was DataFrame.map (the elementwise one, successor of applymap) added? Version number only.
In which exact version of the Python requests library was Response.json() added? Version number only.
In which exact numpy version were the aliases np.float, np.int, np.bool removed (not deprecated)? Version number only.
